title: Sail Darwin!
text:
This was one of the highlights of our visit to Darwin and we can not recommend highly enough.
We arrived at Dock 1 with time to spare and boarded Sundancer about 10 minutes before the cruise left.
After a safety briefing and an introduction to the boat from the Captain we set off.
The sparkling wine flowed freely through out the cruise and there was plenty of cold water and soft drinks on offer.
Roberta and Alida looked after everyone so well, keeping us well feed and ensuring our glasses were never empty. We were served a fabulous array of food including home made beetroot dip and warm pita bread, homemade guacamole with corn chips, prawn dumplings, arancini balls, barramundi bites, chicken satay skewers to name but a few. The food was tasty, well presented and there was plenty of it.
The music was a great range of 80', 90's and more recent tunes.
We cruised along the coast towards Fannie Bay and moored for a period of time to watch the stunning sunset, before cruising back to the dock.
This 3hr relaxing cruise was worth every cent and we will definitely do it again next time we visit Darwin...thank you :)

text:
Booked via website after reading the reviews on all the different cruise companies. Received confirmation via email, boat departed on time. Professional operation.  Boat was not crowded.

Chose beanbag seats (very comfy) at the front on the side, great views both ways. Weather was perfect, sea very flat and smooth.

Friendly staff who constantly topped up the bubbles, which were surprisingly nice! The generous servings of tapas are served in your seats course by course: beetroot dip & pita; corn chips & guacamole; satay chicken skewers; bao buns; arancini balls; gyoza; barramundi; haloumi on zucchini and chocolate cake.  Tip: don’t wear a skirt or white.

Great atmosphere, very relaxing and wonderful way to see the landmarks.

We were treated to an extra ‘show’ on a passing bucks party boat - if you were on our cruise you will know what I’m referring to woof woof bahahahaha.

Highly recommend and we would do again in a heart beat. Worth the extra $ :-)

title: Sail Darwin!
text: We had a wonderful time aboard Sundancer for the evening. The sunset view from this vantage point out on the water is amazing. The food and drinks kept coming all evening, from city views right up to Mindil Beach.  The crew were great, the whole thing was excellent and highly recommended.

title: Sail Darwin!
text: If you want to spend a wonderful evening taking in the beauty of Darwin's coastline and sunset while enjoying great food prepared by a talented and funny chef, champagne, and the light social chat served up by a wonderful crew of attentive and friendly young people, this is the sail for you! This was our 3rd sunset sail this year, and each time has been a session of pampering, laughter and beautiful memories to take home. Special mention must be made of Kerry our hostess, and Jack our skipper, who both made this sail so enjoyable. Their friendly interaction, information sharing and attention to ensuring our time with them was comfortable and relaxing made for a great escape from the 'noise' of life, if only for a few hours. Well done David on having such a great team and sharing your catamaran with us to show off Darwin to our visitors - an indulgent experience for all.

title: Sail Darwin!
text:
Saturday night 7/10/17
What an experience. In an age where service is a hard commodity to find, the crew aboard the Sundancer proved to be attentive, informative, and helpful, all with a smile and enthusiasm you only dream of.
Copious quantities of champagne, 7 course tapas all served in a timely manner with the highest quality of food. I have to mention the music was Brilliant! Getting everyone in the mood for fun. Warm balmy breezes in pristine water, looking at the Darwin skyline while sailing with a glass of champagne good music, and food is an experience you don't want to miss.
The Sunset was spectacular!!

Highly recommended

title: Sail Darwin!
text: We wanted a sailing experience on Darwin Waters as Sail Darwin promoted. Just as we boarded the catamaran & were leaving the marina we were told there will be no sailing as a part was needed to set the sails so only motorised cruising. We could have done this for half the price on another boat. No part refund offered either or option to leave the boat for a full refund. Very spicy food offered too which was disappointing. Make sure you check with the operators before boarding to be assured everything is as offered!
